notes: X12 is a fully passive 2-way coaxial loudspeaker (12" LF cone + 3" neodymium HF compression driver, 8 ohm nominal, 136 dB max SPL, 59 Hz-20 kHz usable bandwidth) requiring an external L-Acoustics amplified controller (LA2Xi/LA4X/LA8/LA12X) — it has no AC/mains power inlet of its own, so no power connector is listed. Both I/O connectors are 4-point speakON (NL4-type); connector id 'speakon' used as the closest match in the allowed list. No bandwidth 'grade' applies to speakON per the spec (grade scale only covers SDI/HDMI/DP/USB/RJ45/etherCON). Not rack-mountable (portable/install cabinet with pole mount, handles, threaded inserts) so rackUnits omitted. Dimensions 430 x 496 x 375 mm, weight 20 kg. Data extracted via WebFetch from the official L-Acoustics product page (l-acoustics.com/products/x12/), which lists connectors as "IN: 1 x 4-point speakON" and "LINK: 1 x 4-point speakON".
